title: Custom right click context menu
when: The user wants a custom menu on right click or long press over items such as files, rows or canvas objects.
inputs: whether a toolbar already offers them
prompt:
Goal: A context menu that opens from mouse, keyboard and touch, follows the menu pattern and never traps the user.
Steps:
1. On contextmenu over the target area call preventDefault and open <ul role="menu" aria-label="Item actions"> at clientX and clientY, clamped inside the viewport.
2. The ContextMenu key and Shift+F10 open it at the focused element; items are <button type="button" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">.
3. ArrowDown and ArrowUp wrap, Home and End jump, Enter runs, Escape closes and refocuses the origin item.
4. Touch: a 500 ms pointerdown timer opens it, cancelled by pointerup or a move over 10 px.
5. Close on outside pointerdown, scroll, resize and blur; disabled items use aria-disabled="true".
Quality bar:
- Every action also exists somewhere visible.
- The menu opens at the pointer.
- The native menu still works outside the target.
Pitfalls:
- Blocking the native menu on the whole page.
- A menu opening off screen near edges.
- Long press that also selects text; set user-select: none on the target.
Verify:
- [ ] role menu with an accessible name.
- [ ] Shift+F10 opens it.
- [ ] Escape returns focus to the origin.
- [ ] It stays inside the viewport.
Output: Menu markup, context-menu.css and context-menu.js wiring the target area.

examples.input: right click menu on file cards with rename and delete
examples.output: role menu opened at pointer, Shift+F10 support, 500 ms long press on touch, Escape back to the card
